Act2-2#1.zh: 你究竟是何人？为何不明就理乱打一通？！
Act2-2#1.t: Who are you, anyway? Why come at us without a word of reason?!

Act2-2#2.zh: 这位师父！我是史家村史进，请收我为徒弟！
Act2-2#2.t: Master! I'm Shi Jin of Shi Family Village. Please take me as your student!

Act2-2#4.zh: 吾乃史家村主人史太公。敢问壮士为何来到敝村？
Act2-2#4.t: I am Squire Shi, head of Shi Family Village. May I ask what brings you to our village, sir?

Act2-2#5.zh: 我名叫%N。同伴有伤，希望太公能让我们借宿一夜。
Act2-2#5.t: My name is %N. One of us is hurt. We hoped you might put us up for the night, Squire.

Act2-2#6.zh: 呵呵...不要说是一夜，住上一年半载也没有问题！但是我有一个条件。当你住在这儿，希望有空闲的时间就稍微调教一下小儿。
Act2-2#6.t: Ho ho... Not just one night, you may stay a year or more! But I have one condition. While you're here, I'd like you to give my boy a little training when you have time.

Act2-2#7.zh: 这位...是令公子？刚才出手太重，还请恕罪。
Act2-2#7.t: This... is your son? Forgive me, I hit him too hard just now.

Act2-2#8.zh: 哪里的话。小儿不懂事，学了些花拳绣腿就想试试自己的功夫；他时常见到过往客人就上前挑战，就算是断手断脚，也是他自作自受。
Act2-2#8.t: Not at all. The boy has no sense. He's learned a few flashy moves and wants to test them, so he challenges every traveller who passes by. If he breaks an arm or a leg, he has only himself to blame.

Act2-2#9.zh: 在下学艺不精，愿师父收留！
Act2-2#9.t: My skills are poor. Please take me on, Master!

Act2-2#10.zh: 老汉世居此华阴县界，前面就是少华山，有山贼出没；此村便叫史家村，村中三四百家都姓史。小儿从小只爱使棒弄枪，老汉只有随他的性子，不知道请了多少师父教他；同时又请了名匠替他刺了这身刺青，全身上下共有九条龙。远近居民都叫他『九纹龙史进』。壮士居然有缘至此，何不传他真材实学，以了老汉之心愿？
Act2-2#10.t: My family has lived here in Huayin County for generations. Ahead lies Mount Shaohua, where bandits roam. This is Shi Family Village; all three or four hundred households here are named Shi. Since he was small my boy has loved nothing but staffs and spears. I let him have his way and hired I don't know how many masters to teach him. I even had a master craftsman tattoo him: nine dragons, all over his body. Folk far and near call him "Nine Dragons Shi Jin". Since fate has brought you here, sir, won't you teach him true skill and grant an old man his wish?

Act2-2#11.zh: 嗯...但是我只会拳脚功夫，更何况也没有教人的经验....
Act2-2#11.t: Well... but I only know fist and foot work, and I've never taught anyone....

Act2-2#12.zh: 这位王教头原本是八十万禁军教头，皇帝身边的禁卫军都是他调教出来的，功力不会在我之下；加上他十八般武艺样样精通，令郎交给他指导必定功力大进。
Act2-2#12.t: Instructor Wang here trained eight hundred thousand Imperial Guards, the very men who guard the Emperor. He's every bit as strong as I am, and a master of all eighteen weapons. Under him your son is sure to improve by leaps and bounds.

Act2-2#14.zh: (这不是很好吗？你们可以在这里休养数天，代价也不过是教导史进功夫；不会是刚被追杀几天，怎么教学生都忘记了吧？)
Act2-2#14.t: (Isn't this perfect? You can rest here a few days, and all it costs is teaching Shi Jin. Don't tell me a few days of being chased made you forget how to teach?)

Act2-2#15.zh: (别...别开玩笑！教了二十年的职业怎么会忘记！)
Act2-2#15.t: (D... don't be ridiculous! I've taught for twenty years, how could I forget!)

Act2-2#16.zh: 那么就太好了！进儿，快来拜师父！
Act2-2#16.t: Then it's settled! Jin, come and bow to your master!

Act2-2#17.zh: 可是，我只服那位大哥的功夫....
Act2-2#17.t: But I only respect that big brother's fighting....

Act2-2#18.zh: 这棒也使得好了，只是有破绽，赢不得真好汉。
Act2-2#18.t: Your staff work is good enough, but it has gaps. It won't beat a true fighter.

Act2-2#19.zh: 俺经了七八个有名的师父，我不信倒不如你！你敢和我扠一扠么？
Act2-2#19.t: I've studied under seven or eight famous masters. I don't believe I'm worse than you! Dare you cross staffs with me?

Act2-2#20.zh: 王进将棒一掣，却望史进怀里直搠将来，只一缴，史进的棒丢在一边，扑地望后倒了。
Act2-2#20.t: Wang Jin swung his staff up and thrust straight at Shi Jin's chest. With one twist, Shi Jin's staff flew aside and he fell flat on his back.

Act2-2#21.zh: ……我枉自经了许多师父，原来不值半分！师父在上，受徒弟一拜！
Act2-2#21.t: ...All those masters, and they weren't worth half a coin! Master, please accept your student's bow!

Act2-2#22.zh: 对了，%X兄，是否能看在老汉的薄面上跟小儿结为义兄弟？
Act2-2#22.t: Oh, and brother %X, for this old man's sake, would you become sworn brothers with my son?

Act2-2#24.t: Big brother, please accept your little brother's bow!

Act2-2#26.zh: 呵呵...今天真是双喜临门！小儿一日中就拜了师父与义兄！%X兄如果没什么紧急事，就暂时住在敝村吧。来人啊！准备宴席，替两位贵客接风！
Act2-2#26.t: Ho ho... Two blessings in one day! In a single day my boy has gained a master and a sworn brother! Brother %X, if nothing urgent calls you, stay in our village for a while. Servants! Prepare a feast to welcome our two honoured guests!

Act2-2#27.zh: 自此王进每日点拨史进：矛、锤、弓、弩、铳，鞭、简、剑、链、挝，斧、钺并戈、戟，牌、棒与枪、杈——十八般武艺，从头指教。
Act2-2#27.t: From then on Wang Jin coached Shi Jin every day in the eighteen arms: spear, hammer, bow, crossbow, gun; whip, mace, sword, chain, claw; axe, halberd, dagger-axe, lance; shield, staff, pike and fork. He taught him everything from the ground up.

Act2-2#28.zh: 主角收服史进，并与史进结为兄弟；史进拜王进为师，一行人遂暂住史家庄。
Act2-2#28.t: The hero won over Shi Jin and swore brotherhood with him. Shi Jin became Wang Jin's student, and the party stayed on at Shi Family Manor.
